about.title: About
about.bio: Full-stack developer based in Chihuahua, Mexico, with 3+ years building production systems: ERP, electronic invoicing SaaS, e-commerce and institutional platforms. At PibyteLabs I maintain the internal TypeScript package ecosystem and am the author of two open-source packages published on npm (listkit and uploaderkit). On mobile, I maintain a React Native/Expo app in open beta with offline-first sync designed end to end.
